title: AeroBind
description: AeroBind is a modern control menu overhaul for Minecraft that introduces instant search, a visual keymap, and smart conflict resolution for a streamlined user experience.
body:
_AeroBind is a mod that makes the Minecraft control menu convenient, clear, and modern. If you're tired of scrolling through a massive list of settings looking for a specific keybind, this mod is the solution._

### 🎮 Why is it so convenient?
- Instant Search: Just start typing the name of the action (e.g., "zoom" or "sprint"), and the mod will immediately highlight the right button. No more endless scrolling!


- Visual Keyboard: There is a virtual keyboard built right into the settings. It shows at a glance which keys are occupied and which are free, making it easy to plan your layout.


- Smart Conflict Resolution ("Solve" Button): Accidentally assigned two functions to one key and everything turned red? Just hit the "Solve" button, and the mod will automatically move conflicting actions to the nearest available keys.

- Key Combinations (Combos): Running out of keys for all your mods? AeroBind allows you to bind actions to combinations, such as Shift + R or Alt + C.


- Useful Filters: Feeling overwhelmed? Use filters to show only the keys active "In-game" (movement, jumping) or only "In-menu" (inventory, settings).


- Quick Settings: Change mouse sensitivity, toggle auto-jump, or invert your mouse directly from the controls menu. No need to back out to the main settings!

- Easy Sorting: Categories can be collapsed or expanded with a single click, allowing you to hide what you don't need right now.

**With AeroBind, customizing your controls is fast, simple, and satisfying!**
